label: Updated at 8 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Beau Hossler leads Wyndham
items.text: Beau Hossler leads the Wyndham Championship at 12-under par, finishing one shot ahead of Ben James and Jordan Smith who tied for second at 11-under.

items.headline: Rory McIlroy At FedEx Cup
items.text: Rory McIlroy confirmed he will return to the FedEx Cup Playoffs at next week's St. Jude Championship in Memphis after skipping last year's opener.

items.headline: DeChambeau Meets LIV Players
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau and LIV Golf CEO Scott O’Neil separately met with LIV players following new funding announced for LIV Golf’s 2027 season and beyond.
